text: dsh-session-cost 是一款面向 DSH Web 客户端的会话费用插件。它在会话列表行、会话悬停卡片和当前会话标题栏显示按 DeepSeek 价格规则估算的金额与用量明细。插件把会话日志中的 provider token 用量汇总为投影数据，客户端按模型和峰谷时段计算费用，并将子代理会话费用合并到所属会话；没有内置定价的模型会标记为未定价。使用时不需要额外 API key。

dsh-session-cost estimates DeepSeek costs in DSH Web. It shows amounts and token details in session rows, hover cards, and the open header. It prices logged provider usage by model and peak/off-peak time, includes subagent costs, and marks unsupported models unpriced. No API key is configured.
我想在 DSH 会话列表里直接看到每个会话花了多少钱。
能不能查看当前对话的 token 用量和费用明细？
Show my estimated DeepSeek spend for each DSH conversation, including its subagents.
dsh-session-cost 的功能「会话费用展示」：按 DeepSeek 定价规则估算已记录 token 用量的费用，并显示在会话行和打开会话的标题栏；悬停会话行可查看本会话与子代理拆分、token 数和调用次数。

dsh-session-cost README · dsh-session-cost — 会话花费：*[English](README.en.md) · 中文*

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：在 Web 界面的**会话列表和会话标题栏**中，显示每个会话
**实际花费的金额**——按会话日志里 provider 上报的真实 token 用量，乘以 **DeepSeek 官方价目表**
（含高峰/空闲时段折扣）计算，并把**子代理会话的费用计入所属会话**。

> 金额是按官方价目表估算的 API 费用：DeepSeek 没有逐笔账单接口，无法从任何数据源读到「这一笔实扣多少钱」，
> 所以本插件给出的是**按官方单价与真实用量算出的金额**；实际扣费以开放平台账单为准（详见
> [计算方式](docs/development.md#计算方式)）。

dsh-session-cost README · 它显示什么：| 位置 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| **会话列表行** | 每个会话右侧常驻一个紧凑金额（如 `¥0.0123`）；悬停显示合计、本会话/子代理拆分、token 与调用次数 |
| **会话悬停卡片** | 该会话的花费明细：合计、本会话与子代理拆分、输入/缓存/输出 token、模型、调用次数 |
| **会话标题栏** | 当前打开会话的实时金额，悬停显示同样的明细 |

特性：

dsh-session-cost README · 它显示什么：- **不占侧栏导航**：只挂在会话行与会话标题栏两处，不新增「全局面板」入口，侧栏面板列表保持原样。
- **按真实用量计价**：读取会话日志里 provider 上报的 `usage`（未命中缓存的输入、缓存命中、缓存写入、输出
  分开计价），不是按字符数的估算。
- **峰谷时段**：Beijing 时间工作日 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 为高峰（标准价），其余时间（含周末与法定节假日
  全天）为空闲时段，按高峰价的 50% 计价；每次调用按自己的完成时刻判定档位。
- **子代理合并**：父会话的金额包含它派生的所有子代理会话，费用只计一次；悬停明细里可以看到拆分。
- **未定价模型不糊弄**：价目表之外的模型只统计 token、不计金额，并明确标注「未定价」，不会假装是 0 元。
- **中英双语、明暗主题**：跟随 Harness 的界面语言与主题，不写死颜色。
- 零依赖、零构建步骤：`client.js` 已作为构建产物提交，安装即用；Host 半边只注册一个会话投影，不注入工具、
  不写会话日志。

dsh-session-cost README · 如何计算：```
每次调用费用 = (缓存未命中输入 × 未命中单价
              + 缓存命中输入 × 命中单价
              + 缓存写入 × 写入单价
              + 输出 token × 输出单价) / 1,000,000

单价来自 DeepSeek 官方价格页的 **人民币价目表**（元 / 百万 tokens），空闲时段为高峰价 × 0.5：

| 模型 | 缓存命中（峰/闲） | 缓存未命中（峰/闲） | 输出（峰/闲） |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deepseek-flash` | ¥0.04 / ¥0.02 | ¥2 / ¥1 | ¥8 / ¥4 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | ¥0.30 / ¥0.15 | ¥9 / ¥4.5 | ¥27 / ¥13.5 |

价目表、峰谷规则、节假日与计算公式都在 [`src/pricing.js`](src/pricing.js) 一处维护，核对日期与来源见
[docs/development.md](docs/development.md)。

dsh-session-cost README · 安装：本插件是标准 DSH bundle，安装后**刷新页面**即可生效：

1. **界面安装（推荐）**：设置 → 插件 → 在安装框粘贴本仓库地址（例如 `https://github.com/hojas/dsh-session-cost`）
   或本目录的绝对路径 → 安装 → 刷新页面。
2. **命令行安装**（`desktop` 配置档由桌面应用独占，只能用界面安装；其它配置档可用）：
   ```sh
   dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <插件目录或仓库地址>
   ```
3. **tarball**：`pnpm pack` 后，在安装框粘贴 `.tgz` 的绝对路径。

从**本地目录**安装时 DSH 会以 `link:` 挂载该目录，改完 `src/client/*.js` 后运行
`node scripts/build-client.mjs`，刷新页面即可看到新界面，不必重装。

dsh-session-cost README · 使用：装好并刷新后：

- 侧栏会话列表里每个会话行右侧会出现金额；鼠标悬停该行查看明细。
- 打开一个会话，标题栏右侧会显示当前会话的金额。
- 没有独立的「会话花费」页面：插件不注册侧栏全局面板入口，金额只出现在会话行与会话标题栏。

dsh-session-cost README · 已知限制：- **金额是估算值**：DeepSeek 官方没有提供逐笔账单/发票查询接口，插件只能按「真实用量 × 官方单价」给出金额；
  实际扣费以开放平台账单为准。
- **少数内部调用不计入**：会话标题生成、网页搜索/抓取等 DSH 内部调用在会话日志里不记录 provider usage，
  无法计价；这些调用的金额很小，但不为零。
- **价目表随官方调整**：当前价目表核对于 2026-10-22，峰谷方案自 2026-09-10 生效；官方调价或调整时段后需要
  更新 [`src/pricing.js`](src/pricing.js)。节假日日历目前覆盖 2026 年，其它年份按「只有周末空闲」近似。
- **模型覆盖**：价目表内置 `deepseek-flash`、`deepseek-v4-pro`（以及按官方口径计为 flash 的
  `deepseek-v4-flash*` 别名）；接入其它 provider/model 时只会统计 token，金额标注为未定价。
- **子代理合并依赖宿主投影**：合并只统计通过 DSH 子代理机制创建、且日志仍在的会话；被删除的会话无法补算。

dsh-session-cost README · 兼容性：- 目标环境：DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`（建库时验证）与 `0.2.1-rc.3`（2026-10-24 复验安装、启动与客户端下发；槽位名未变）。
  macOS 桌面版自带运行时，Web 配置档同样可用。
- 客户端产物已提交进仓库，安装过程不需要 Node 工具链，也不需要执行构建脚本。
- 依赖的宿主契约：`sessionProjections`（Host 会话投影）、`session/projections` 与 `session/control`
  （客户端投影传输）、以及 `sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action` / `sidebar.session.row.hover` /
  `conversation.session.header.utilities` 槽位。DSH 大版本升级后需要核对槽位名。

dsh-session-cost README · dsh-session-cost — per-session cost：*English · [中文](README.md) — this is the English edition of [README.md](README.md), which stays canonical.*

A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin that shows **how much each session actually cost** in the Web UI — in the
**session list** and the **session header**. Amounts are computed from the
provider-reported token usage recorded in each session log, multiplied by the **official DeepSeek CNY price
list** (peak/off-peak aware), with **subagent sessions attributed to the session that spawned them**.

dsh-session-cost README · dsh-session-cost — per-session cost：> Amounts are estimates from official prices: DeepSeek exposes no per-request billing API, so no data source
> can report "what this exact call was charged". The plugin reports usage × official unit price; the DeepSeek
> platform bill remains authoritative (see [how it is computed](docs/development.md#how-it-is-computed)).

dsh-session-cost README · What it shows：| Where | What |
| --- | --- |
| **Session list rows** | A compact amount (e.g. `¥0.0123`) at the right of every session row; hover for total, own/subagent split, tokens and call count |
| **Session row hover card** | Cost detail for that session: total, own vs subagent split, input/cache/output tokens, model, calls |
| **Session header** | Live amount for the open session, with the same detail on hover |

Highlights:

dsh-session-cost README · What it shows：- **No extra sidebar navigation** — the amount sits on the session row and in the header; the plugin adds no
  global-panel entry, so the sidebar's panel list stays as it was.
- **Real usage, not a character estimate** — reads the `usage` the provider reported in the session log
  (uncached input, cache reads, cache writes and output are priced separately).
- **Peak / off-peak aware** — Beijing-time weekdays 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 are peak (standard price);
  everything else, including weekends and Chinese statutory holidays all day, is off-peak at 50% of the peak
  price. Each call is priced by its own completion instant.
- **Subagents included** — a parent session's amount includes every subagent session it created, counted once;
  the hover detail breaks the sum down.
- **Honest about unpriced models** — models outside the price table contribute tokens but no money and are
  clearly marked unpriced instead of being shown as ¥0.
- **Bilingual, theme-aware** — follows the Harness UI language and light/dark themes; no hardcoded colors.
- Zero dependencies and no install-time build: the built `client.js` is committed, and the host half on

dsh-session-cost README · How it is computed：```
cost per call = (uncached input × miss rate
               + cache-read input × hit rate
               + cache write × write rate
               + output tokens × output rate) / 1,000,000

Rates come from the official DeepSeek **CNY** price page (CNY per million tokens); off-peak is 50% of peak:

dsh-session-cost README · How it is computed：| Model | Cache hit (peak/off) | Cache miss (peak/off) | Output (peak/off) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deepseek-flash` | ¥0.04 / ¥0.02 | ¥2 / ¥1 | ¥8 / ¥4 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | ¥0.30 / ¥0.15 | ¥9 / ¥4.5 | ¥27 / ¥13.5 |

The price table, peak schedule, holidays and formula all live in [`src/pricing.js`](src/pricing.js); the
verified date and source are documented in [docs/development.md](docs/development.md).

dsh-session-cost README · Install：1. **Through the UI (recommended)**: Settings → Plugins → paste this repository's URL (e.g.
   `https://github.com/hojas/dsh-session-cost`) or the absolute path of this directory → install → refresh.
2. **Through the CLI** (`desktop` is owned by the desktop app and only accepts UI installs; other profiles
   work): `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <directory-or-repository>`.
3. **Through a tarball**: `pnpm pack`, then paste the `.tgz` absolute path in the install box.

dsh-session-cost README · Install：A local-directory install is mounted as a `link:`; after editing `src/client/*.js`, run
`node scripts/build-client.mjs` and refresh the page — no reinstall needed.

dsh-session-cost README · Known limitations：- **Amounts are estimates.** DeepSeek exposes no per-call billing/invoice API; the plugin multiplies real usage
  by official unit prices. The platform bill remains authoritative.
- **A few internal calls are not counted.** Session-title generation and web search/fetch LLM requests do not
  record provider usage in the session log, so they cannot be priced. They are small, but not zero.
- **Prices change.** The table was verified on 2026-10-22 and the peak/off-peak scheme has been in force since
  2026-09-10; update [`src/pricing.js`](src/pricing.js) when DeepSeek changes prices or windows. The holiday
  calendar covers 2026; other years are approximated as "weekends only".
- **Model coverage.** The built-in table covers `deepseek-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro` (plus the
  `deepseek-v4-flash*` aliases that the official page bills as flash). Other providers/models contribute
  tokens only and are marked unpriced.
- **Subagent aggregation depends on the host projection.** Only sessions created through DSH's subagent
  mechanism and whose logs still exist can be merged; deleted sessions cannot be recovered.

dsh-session-cost README · Compatibility：- Target: DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` (verified when the plugin was built) and `0.2.1-rc.3` (2026-10-24 re-verified for
  install, boot and client-bundle delivery; slot names unchanged). The macOS desktop bundle ships the runtime;
  the Web profile works too.
- The client artifact is committed, so installation needs no Node toolchain and runs no build script.
- Host contracts used: `sessionProjections` (host session projections), `session/projections` +
  `session/control` (client projection transport), and the `sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action` /
  `sidebar.session.row.hover` / `conversation.session.header.utilities` slots.
  Check those names after a DSH major upgrade.
